mapper.sql: photo_id, user_id, site_id, file_key, has_other_face, is_private, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo (user_id, site_id, file_key, has_other_face, is_private) VALUES (#{userId}, #{siteId}, #{fileKey}, #{hasOtherFace}, #{isPrivate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_key = VALUES(file_key), has_other_face = VALUES(has_other_face)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM photo WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE photo SET is_private = #{isPrivate} WHERE photo_id = #{photoId}
